label: nyiso 53 li tsl
definition: L-11 probe: nyiso-52 recipe + Zone-K LCR/TSL import cap (nyiso_li_lcr_tsl, issue #1345 — replaces the LI 0.45 self-supply floor; published locality import limit, HB14-21 window) + use_plant_emission_rates_v2=True (§9.6 ride-along).
market_story: ST_GAS +2.7/+3.8/+3.9 TWh and CT_PEAKER +1.1/+0.9/+0.6 TWh vs the zero-forcing twin, displacing CC (-2.3/-3.1/-3.0): NYISO really does commit its downstate steam and peaker fleet out of merit for local reliability (DARU/SRE commitments, steamer minimum-run blocks, the PR-#1442 CAMPD-derived temperature windows) — behaviour a pure-ED LP cannot produce. Even WITH the floors both classes still under-run the measured actuals (ST_GAS 7.2/8.1/10.3 vs 8.7/11.1/16.0; CT_PEAKER 1.3/1.4/2.4 vs 2.3/2.1/2.8 TWh), so the floors move dispatch toward measured, never past it; the remaining gap is the #1344 reserve-scarcity commitment frontier (data-blocked, Ask-B). The former nyiso_local_selfsupply floor contributes nothing here — the Zone-K TSL import cap replaced it (issue #1345) and LI energy clears economically.
